audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phase sides gave you levels 3, 6 and two items, directly contradicting whys[2] ('the level reads even'), whys[4] ('that's her real spike') and whys[6] ('pull it even').
audit.why: Her tentacle count and Prophet of an Elder God sustain overtake chip damage from level 4, Leap of Faith is her level-6 spike, and a bruiser item outlasts your poke.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] was marked yours with 'Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and spawns a tentacle per champion hit; Jayce gets nothing new at 6 because his R is the stance-swap.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named as her spike with the 120s cost of a missed one.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] and early tell you that a landed Test of Spirit means you must sprint away from your own spawned tentacle.
audit.why: Riot's text is the opposite: the spirit echoes a share of the damage it takes to you, and if it is killed OR you get too far from it you become a Vessel and start spawning tentacles yourself. Running is what makes you a Vessel.
audit.corrected: Do not run from the spirit — leave her tentacle radius without breaking leash, and never fight next to a cluster.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on any of her tools.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s, and Harsh Lesson a flat 4s — the last one is why a single Thundering Blow does not buy you an escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid, late and all seven whys are first-person.
audit.why: Breaks the second-person coaching voice used everywhere else.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in your voice, meaning unchanged.

audit.why: It is a 4s targeted leap that is also an auto-attack reset and makes every nearby tentacle swing at you — the leap wind-up, not the tentacle animation, is the cue to knock her back.
audit.corrected: Named in the Key Ability Interactions block.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are clean for me: I take Cannon Q and gate-Q every step-up she makes to last-hit, and with only one or two tentacles up she has no dash to dodge the accelerated orb. The one thing that ends my early lead is Test of Spirit — if she lands that E on me I have to sprint away from my own slapped spirit or eat a chunk of max HP, so I poke from outside E range and never linger next to a tentacle. Bank her health down for plates; do not walk into the wave to fish a Hammer combo while her E is up.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are clean for you: take Cannon Q and gate-Q every step-up she makes to last-hit, and with only one or two tentacles up she has no dash to dodge the accelerated orb. The one thing that ends your early lead is Test of Spirit — the spirit echoes damage onto you, and breaking away from it turns you into a Vessel, so poke from outside her 900-range E and never linger next to a tentacle. Bank her health down for plates; do not walk into the wave to fish a Hammer combo while her E is up.

edits.before: This is where it tips to her. By Levels 4-6 her tentacle count has climbed and her passive slam-healing plus Test of Spirit lifesteal restore everything I poked, so the chip war I was winning stops mattering. At 6 her Leap of Faith drops a whole ring of bonus tentacles — that is the spike, not mine, since my R is only the stance-swap I already had. If she ults on me, my Thundering Blow knockback buys exactly one reset off the cluster, not an escape from the field, so I disengage with the Hextech Capacitor move speed instead of trading inside it. Only commit when her E and R are both on cooldown.
edits.after: This is where it tips to her. By Levels 4-6 her tentacle count has climbed and her passive slam-healing plus Test of Spirit restore everything you poked, so the chip war you were winning stops mattering. At 6 her Leap of Faith drops a tentacle for every champion it hits — that is the spike, not yours, since your R is only the stance-swap you already had. If she ults on you, Thundering Blow buys exactly one reset off the cluster and her 4s Harsh Lesson brings her straight back, so disengage on Hextech Capacitor speed instead of trading inside it.

edits.before: Late, she is the one who scales here — a full tentacle field plus a bruiser-tank item means she out-sustains my poke and turns any grouped fight into a vessel-pull bloodbath, while I am still the squishy caster who built zero defense. I keep a slight edge only by never being in her field: gate-Q her from max range, Thundering Blow her off the tentacles if she dives, and refuse the 1v1 on her terms. Spend every lead I banked early on plates and side-lane pressure before two items, because once she is tanky the lane goes even and the teamfight goes to her.
